title: Nonvanishing derived limits from $\clubsuit$-type principles
summary: Combinatorial set theory provides several tools to study derived limits of certain inverse systems of abelian groups. Most known nonvanishing results for $\lim^n$ with $n>1$ depend on some guessing principles of the form $\mathrm{w}\lozenge(S)$ called weak diamonds. In this paper, we explore some applications of the guessing principle $\clubsuit(S)$ and its weakenings instead.
